title: epack validation profile
description: A profile states the controls an evidence pack is checked against. Each requirement is a control: its name is the statement a reviewer reads, and its clauses are the tests that verify it against artifacts in the pack.

version.description: Profile version. Quote it in YAML so 1.0 stays a string.

id.description: Unique within the profile. Results, overlays and control mappings refer to it, so keep it stable once published.

control.description: Framework control this requirement answers, such as CC6.1.

name.description: The control statement a reviewer reads, such as "MFA is enforced for every user".

description.description: What satisfies the requirement, in prose. Echoed beside the result.

manual.description: True when no machine check answers the requirement. It is answered by control mappings and human review, and is never scored.

satisfied_by.description: Exactly one of any_of or all_of.

any_of.description: The requirement is met when any clause matches.

all_of.description: The requirement is met when every clause matches.

type.description: Artifact type the clause reads, such as evidencepack/idp-posture@v1.

severity.description: Set on a clause that describes a failure. A matching clause with a severity marks the requirement as failing at that severity. Leave empty for a clause that describes a pass.

max_age_days.description: The artifact must have been collected within this many days.

metadata_conditions.description: What the artifact must show. A clause without conditions matches any artifact of its type that it applies to. Required when applicable_when has a cardinality each condition.

all.description: Every condition must hold for the clause to match.

gate.description: When the clause applies. A clause whose conditions here are false reads not_applicable and is set aside when the requirement combines its clauses. A value these conditions need that is absent makes the clause unknown, never not_applicable.

type.description: Artifact type the conditions read. Defaults to the clause's own type. With another type, the clause applies when the conditions hold on any artifact of that type.

all.description: Every condition must hold for the clause to apply.

path.description: JSONPath into the artifact, such as $.user_security.mfa_coverage_pct. Paths with [*] or .. need a cardinality.

op.description: Comparison. Numeric operators compare numbers only; eq and neq compare exactly, with no conversion between strings and numbers.

value.description: Value to compare against. Not used by exists and not_exists.

cardinality.description: How a multi-value path is scored: all values, any value, or no value must satisfy the condition. each is allowed only in applicable_when, on a path with one [*], and decides the condition for each element of the list before the [*]: elements it rules out are skipped, and the clause's conditions on that list grade the rest.
